findings.label: Self-booking fail-open when cognitoSub null
findings.description: Both booking handlers skip the self-booking check if either user's cognitoSub is null. A physio with a legacy record (null cognitoSub) could book themselves as a patient. Consider logging a warning when cognitoSub is missing and the check is skipped, or treating null-null as a blocking condition.

findings.label: Pool A hardcoded fallback
findings.description: multiPoolVerifier.ts falls back to hardcoded Pool A ID ap-south-1_AulfstD9s when COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID is unset. This matches existing codebase pattern but means deployment without env vars silently targets production Pool A. No action required if intentional.
